name: Divine Truths of the Arcane
body:
You can sacrifice divine magical energy in order to gain insights into magical arcana and spells.

Prerequisite(s): Knowledge (religion) 5 ranks, Spellcraft 5 ranks, 1st-level Mystic Theurge

Benefit: By sacrificing an uncast divine spell that you had prepared, you are able to gain a bonus to a Knowledge (arcana) or Spellcraft skill check equal to twice the level of the spell sacrificed, or a bonus equal to the level of the spell sacrificed to a single caster level check that you make in order to penetrate a creature’s spell resistance. Using this ability is a swift action, and you may use it a number of times per day equal to one half of your mystic theurge level (minimum 1).
